rangeHint.zh: 上下限可独立留空，留空表示不限制。大小单位按 1024 换算。
rangeHint.en: Leave either bound empty for no limit. Size units use powers of 1024.

rangeTimeHint.zh: 电脑本地时间，精确到分钟；留空表示不限制。
rangeTimeHint.en: Computer local time, to the minute; leave empty for no limit.

rangeFallback.zh: 此表达式保留原文，请在此编辑。
rangeFallback.en: This expression is preserved; edit it here.

rangeNumber.zh: 请输入非负整数，换算后的字节数不能超过 18446744073709551615。
rangeNumber.en: Enter a nonnegative integer; bytes must not exceed 18446744073709551615.

rangeDate.zh: 请输入有效的本地日期和时间（YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm）。
rangeDate.en: Enter a valid local date and time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm).

rangeOrder.zh: 下限不能大于上限；相同时两个边界必须都包含。
rangeOrder.en: The lower bound must precede the upper bound, or both must include the same value.

rootBatchHint.zh: 选择或管理目录；以下设置应用于本次添加的所有目录。
rootBatchHint.en: Choose or manage folders. These settings apply to all folders being added.

watchHint.zh: 监控目录中的直接文件。
watchHint.en: Monitors files directly inside each folder.

rootOutput.zh: 输出目录；留空使用默认位置
rootOutput.en: Output folder; leave blank for the default

startupDescription.zh: 登录 Windows 后自动监控目录。
startupDescription.en: Automatically monitor folders when you sign in to Windows.

themeDescription.zh: 选择管理面板的显示外观。

scopeDescription.zh: 包含所选目录的子目录。请至少添加一个目录。
scopeDescription.en: Includes subfolders. Add at least one folder.

scopeRequired.zh: 请添加目录，或选择“全部目录”。
scopeRequired.en: Add a folder or select All folders.

importHint.zh: 每行导入一个条目，忽略空行；密码和规则保留首尾空格。先预览，再导入。
importHint.en: One entry per line; blank lines are skipped. Password and rule whitespace is preserved. Preview before importing.

unsavedEntries.zh: 请先保存或取消当前编辑。
unsavedEntries.en: Save or cancel the current edit first.

finishImport.zh: 请先预览并导入，或清空批量输入。
finishImport.en: Preview and import the batch, or clear the import text first.

fileProblems.zh: 部分数据暂时无法读取
fileProblems.en: Some data could not be read

cliEncoding.zh: 命令输出不是有效的 UTF-8。
cliEncoding.en: The command output is not valid UTF-8.

unknownDescription.zh: 附加配置；保留原值及其他未知配置。
unknownDescription.en: Additional setting. Other unrecognized values are preserved.

validation.zh: 输入值不符合此项说明。
validation.en: Enter a value within the limits described above.

conflict.zh: 该项已被其他程序修改。刷新后重新编辑。
conflict.en: This setting changed in another program. Refresh and edit it again.

rootConflict.zh: 此监控目录已被其他程序修改，请放弃更改后重新编辑。
rootConflict.en: This monitored folder changed in another program. Discard changes and edit it again.

configConflict.zh: 配置已在外部删除，请放弃更改后重新编辑。
configConflict.en: A setting was removed externally. Discard changes and edit it again.

settingChanged.zh: 该字段已被外部修改，请重新选择后保存
settingChanged.en: This setting changed in another program. Review the latest value and edit it again.

settingTypeMismatch.zh: 输入类型与字段类型不一致
settingTypeMismatch.en: The value has the wrong type for this setting.

passwordChanged.zh: 密码记录已被外部修改，请重新选择
passwordChanged.en: This password changed in another program. Open it again to edit the latest value.

passwordScopeAbsolute.zh: 密码作用域必须是 Windows 绝对目录
passwordScopeAbsolute.en: Password folders must use absolute Windows paths.

rootInvalid.zh: 目录不能为空且不能包含分隔符或换行
rootInvalid.en: The folder must not be empty or contain separators or line breaks.

rootMissing.zh: 监控目录必须是已存在的文件夹
rootMissing.en: Choose an existing folder to monitor.

rootRemoved.zh: 监控目录已被外部删除
rootRemoved.en: This monitored folder was removed in another program.

pathMissing.en: The path does not currently exist.

explorerFailed.zh: 无法在资源管理器中打开路径
explorerFailed.en: Could not open the path in Explorer.

cliMissing.zh: 未找到 SunPack CLI；请安装完整发行包或传入 --cli
cliMissing.en: SunPack CLI was not found. Install the complete package or specify --cli.

cliUnbound.zh: 测试数据目录未绑定 CLI；请显式传入 --cli
cliUnbound.en: This data folder has no CLI configured. Specify --cli.

configObjectRequired.zh: 配置顶层必须是 JSON 对象
configObjectRequired.en: The configuration must be a JSON object.

fileTooLarge.zh: 文件超过可编辑大小限制
fileTooLarge.en: The file exceeds the editable size limit.

watchNotificationsUnsupported.zh: 目录不支持文件变化通知
watchNotificationsUnsupported.en: The folder does not support file change notifications.

folderPickerFailed.en: Could not open the folder picker.

logRecordTooLarge.zh: 日志单行超过大小限制
logRecordTooLarge.en: A log entry exceeds the size limit.

passwordScopesEmpty.zh: 目录密码的 scopes 不能为空
passwordScopesEmpty.en: A folder password needs at least one folder.

passwordUnicodeRequired.zh: 密码及作用域必须是无 NUL 的有效 Unicode 字符串
passwordUnicodeRequired.en: Passwords and folders must be valid Unicode without NUL characters.

passwordArrayRequired.zh: 密码文件必须包含 passwords 数组
passwordArrayRequired.en: The password file must contain a passwords array.

passwordFileUnknownField.en: The password file contains an unknown property.

passwordValueRequired.en: A password record is missing its value.

passwordRecordUnknownField.en: A password record contains an unknown property.

clipboardArrayRequired.en: Clipboard history must be an array.

scopeNotDirect.zh: 只能移除直接绑定的作用域
scopeNotDirect.en: Only directly assigned folders can be removed.

scopeInherited.zh: 当前目录不是直接作用域
scopeInherited.en: This folder is inherited and cannot be removed here.

rootsLineInvalid.zh: 监控目录每行最多包含 input | output | deep_detect
rootsLineInvalid.en: Each monitored-folder line accepts input | output | deep_detect.

deepDetectInvalid.zh: deep_detect 只能是 true 或 false
deepDetectInvalid.en: Deep detection must be true or false.

guiArguments.zh: 参数：--data-dir <目录> --cli <可执行文件> [--cli-prefix <单个参数>]...

uiBindingFailed.en: Could not update the interface data.

taskBindingFailed.en: Could not update the task list.

logoLoadFailed.zh: 无法加载 SunPack 图标资源
logoLoadFailed.en: Could not load the SunPack logo.

layoutLoadFailed.zh: 无法加载管理面板布局
layoutLoadFailed.en: Could not load the manager layout.

cliOperationUnknown.zh: 不支持的 CLI 操作

windowsMessageUnavailable.zh: 系统未提供此错误的说明
windowsMessageUnavailable.en: No system message is available for this error.

invalidJson.zh: JSON 格式无效，请检查第 {byte} 字节附近

opCliAttributes.zh: 设置 CLI 进程属性

opCliHandles.zh: 设置 CLI 进程句柄

opFindLogo.zh: 查找 SunPack 图标资源

description.zh: 保存后同时用于管理面板和命令行。
description.en: Applies to the manager and CLI after saving.

description.zh: 处理压缩包内的压缩包；指定轮数时至少为 1。
description.en: Extract archives found inside archives; fixed rounds must be at least 1.

description.zh: 根据压缩包占比决定是否继续解压。
description.en: Use archive ratios to decide whether to keep extracting.

description.zh: 正数提高评分，负数降低评分。
description.en: Positive values raise the score; negative values lower it.
0–1; continue extracting at or above this score.

description.zh: 0–1；压缩包占总大小的最低比例。
description.en: 0–1; minimum share of total size occupied by archives.

description.zh: 输出只有一层文件夹时，将内容上移一层。
description.en: Move contents up one level when there is only one output folder.

description.zh: 监控模式只处理各目录中的直接文件。
description.en: Watch handles files directly inside each monitored folder.
Filter files using the rules below.

description.zh: 跳过匹配的目录和路径。
支持通配符，可逐项管理规则。
支持通配符，可逐项管理规则。
只处理符合下方条件的文件。
description.en: Process only files matching the conditions below.

description.zh: 支持通配符，可逐项管理规则。
支持通配符，可逐项管理规则。
扩展名如 .zip；也会影响伪装扩展名的压缩包。
description.en: Extensions such as .zip; also affects archives with disguised extensions.

description.zh: 跳过下方文件名和扩展名。
description.en: Skip the file names and extensions below.

description.zh: 扩展名如 .zip；也会影响伪装扩展名的压缩包。
description.en: Extensions such as .zip; also affects archives with disguised extensions.

description.zh: 设置文件大小的上下限，并选择是否包含边界。
description.en: Set lower and upper file sizes and choose whether to include each boundary.

description.zh: 按电脑本地时间设置固定的起止日期和时间。
description.en: Set fixed start and end dates and times in computer local time.
Exit after this much idle time.

description.zh: 任务长期无进展时判定超时。
description.en: Time out tasks that stop making progress.

description.zh: 至少 1；防止低优先级任务一直等待。
description.en: At least 1; prevent low-priority tasks from waiting indefinitely.

label.zh: 资源不足时暂停新任务
label.en: Pause new tasks when resources are low

description.zh: 等待内存和磁盘空间恢复后继续。
description.en: Resume when memory and disk space are available.

description.zh: 至少 1；仅在资源不足时复查。
description.en: At least 1; recheck only while resources are low.

label.zh: 资源状态报告间隔（毫秒）

description.en: 0–1; pause new tasks below this value.

description.zh: 后台模式减少对其他程序的影响。
description.en: Background mode reduces the impact on other apps.

description.zh: 非负数；发现新文件后等待多久再处理。
description.en: Non-negative; wait this long before processing a new file.

description.zh: 非负数；文件停止变化后再等待多久。
description.en: Non-negative; wait this long after a file stops changing.

description.zh: 不小于首次处理等待和最短稳定等待。
description.en: Must cover both the initial delay and minimum stable time.

description.zh: 非负数；再次确认文件已停止写入。
description.en: Non-negative; confirm that the file has stopped being written.

description.zh: 停止文件监控时最多等待多久。
description.en: Maximum wait when stopping the file watcher.

description.zh: 空闲时释放可重建的缓存。

description.en: Clear caches after this much idle time.

description.zh: 合并短时间内重复的重试请求。
description.en: Combine repeated retry requests within this interval.

description.zh: 将剪贴板中的密码候选存入历史。
description.en: Save clipboard password candidates in history.

description.zh: 至少 1；超出时移除最旧的记录。
description.en: At least 1; remove oldest entries when full.

description.zh: 控制主程序启动行为；当前监控在任务页启停。
description.en: Sets startup behavior; use Tasks to start or stop the current Watch.

description.zh: 附加监控目录，可逐项管理。
“.” 表示输入目录旁；可按监控目录单独设置。
description.en: “.” places output beside the input; each monitored folder can override it.

description.zh: 在 Windows 通知区域显示图标。
description.en: Show an icon in the Windows notification area.

label.zh: 结果通知合并间隔（毫秒）

description.zh: 合并连续完成的结果通知。

description.en: At least 1; remove expired reports automatically.

description.zh: 留空使用数据目录下的 .sunpack_watch。
description.en: Leave blank to use .sunpack_watch in the data folder.

description.zh: 尝试用当前剪贴板文本解密。
description.en: Try the current clipboard text as a password.

description.zh: 可选择只接受完整结果，或允许恢复部分内容。
description.en: Require complete results or allow partial recovery.

description.zh: 查找夹在其他数据中的压缩包。
description.en: Find archives embedded inside other data.

description.zh: 0–1；控制内嵌压缩包的递归筛选。
description.en: 0–1; controls selection of embedded archives for nested extraction.

description.zh: 复用已分析的输入计划。
分析压缩包时共用的缓存大小。
description.en: Cache shared by archive analysis tasks.

description.zh: 分析一个压缩包最多读取的数据量。
description.en: Maximum data read when analyzing one archive.

description.zh: 先读取文件两端，辅助识别格式。
description.en: Read both ends of a file to help identify its format.
0–1; accept an archive for extraction at or above this value.

description.zh: 移除验证失败产生的不完整文件。
description.en: Remove incomplete output after failed verification.
Limited by the retry count above.

description.zh: 检查解压程序的退出结果。
检查是否生成输出文件。
description.en: Check that output files were created.

description.zh: 比对预期文件数量和大小。
description.en: Compare expected file counts and sizes.

label.zh: 允许的文件数量比例差

description.zh: 使用压缩包校验信息检查完整性。
按内容识别格式，支持伪装扩展名和分卷。
description.en: Identify formats by content, including disguised extensions and split volumes.
